scripts.build: pnpm --filter @deck-drive/card-definitions build && pnpm --filter @deck-drive/pack-engine build && pnpm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @deck-drive/card-definitions build && pnpm --filter @deck-drive/game-engine build && pnpm --filter @deck-drive/pack-engine build && pnpm run prisma:generate && tsx src/server.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @deck-drive/card-definitions build && pnpm --filter @deck-drive/game-engine build && pnpm --filter @deck-drive/pack-engine build && pnpm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run prisma:seed:check
scripts.replay: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @deck-drive/game-engine build && tsx ../../scripts/replay/index.ts
